task: Implement proof admissibility registry MVP for the first M0/M1 slice of proof-admissibility hardening.
outcome: After build, the user can run `npm --prefix packages/main run test:proof-admissibility` and see `proof-admissibility smoke passed`, plus API/JSON outputs can classify proof-looking surfaces as admissible or inadmissible with stable scope and reason codes such as `scope_not_allowed_for_claim`, `authority_receipt_requires_gate_decision`, and `local_diagnostic_not_authority`.
facts: B-0aa1 already added candidate-only evidence storage under .lattice/evidence.
The plan says M0 inventory and M1 shared registry are blockers before warn/enforce gate integration.
Current gates already have some per-surface protections, but no single shared admissibility classifier.
This story is classification/warn foundation only and must not hard-fail existing gates.
constraints: Do not implement Authority Server changes in this story.
Do not turn local-key or candidate evidence into production proof.
Do not write a new storage root separate from .lattice/evidence.
Do not directly edit docs/story or tests/fixtures.
Expose structured reason codes for operator/developer visibility.
unknowns: Exact future gate-integration consumers may evolve in later M4-M7 stories, so this MVP should keep the registry extensible.
